about: I’m a Computer Science and Engineering student at the Islamic University of Technology in Bangladesh, expecting to graduate in 2028. My coursework spans algorithms, software engineering, and systems analysis and design, and I like understanding how a system works before building on top of it.

Most of my learning happens by building. My personal and academic projects include a Bangla price-tracking web platform, a retro logic-puzzle game written in Java, and a console-based café management system in C++. I care about software that is useful, readable, and straightforward to maintain.

Beyond web development I’m drawn to AI and machine learning, including generative AI, AI agents and computer vision, as well as robotics and problem-solving. Gatekeeper, my logic-puzzle game, sits where several of those interests overlap.
